reviews.text: We had a gate added to our iron fence. The installation was smooth and easy. We ended up having an issue arise a couple weeks later and Andy and Trey were on the ball and came right out to fix it. Grateful for the help!
reviews.author: Kari Beckstrand

reviews.text: We had a custom built gate we’ve taken with us when we’ve moved a couple of times, installed in an “existing” fence. All American Fence sent one talented fellow, Greg McShan to do the install. He is truly a master because he had to fabricate a smaller opening in a fence someone else installed, which is on a slope. Let’s just say, he found a solution that allows us to have our lovely gate solidly installed and trimmed to look like it belongs!  He discussed all the options and listened to my input.  We recommend All American Fencing and Greg McShan without reservation!
reviews.author: Jama Rand

reviews.text: I needed a new fence to corral escape-artist dogs while improving access to the back of my property.  What started as a sketch based on my vision was brought to life by All American Fence.  They listened and they delivered.  Everyone involved was easy to work with.  I highly recommend this fence company and plan to use them again for future projects.
reviews.author: Susan Davis

reviews.text: Sept 2025:ALL AMERICAN FENCE REPAIR LLC did an awesome job fixing my broken wood fence posts & replacing them with metal posts. Andy coordinated & gave me a couple options -- Chase inspected & we decided on replacing 4 posts.  Chase was here the next day to fix the fence. It looks great. Chase & Andy are super nice, listen well, and are very respectful. i will definitely  use them again.
reviews.author: KCX

reviews.text: Hands down the best in the business. Our project manager Andy, was professional, communicative and very helpful. Trey got our fence replaced in a timely manner & from one look at the fence you can tell it is top notch. Great work guys. I highly recommend All American Fence. Whether you need a small repair or a full replacement, these are the go to guys for all your fencing needs.
reviews.author: Jason Dolly

reviews.text: Working with All American Fence Repair was a breeze. Our project manager, Andy, was extremely helpful and professional. Our installer, Trey, was on time and exceeded expectations. Would highly recommend to anyone looking for a top notch fence contractor.
reviews.author: Andrew I.

reviews.text: I got quotes from a number of other companies, All American Fence Repair gave the best price for materials and labor. They work within my schedule. I am very pleased.
reviews.author: Sam Ybarra

reviews.text:
Andy is great at what he does!!
Great experience with All American Fence Repair! They installed my fence quickly and the quality is excellent. Professional, reliable, and fair pricing. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Shaj “Shaj”
